info.title: Product Catalog API
info.description: Reads and maintains catalog products with their categories, subcategories and typed details, and imports products from an Excel workbook.

x-sap-shortText: Reads and maintains catalog products with their categories, subcategories and typed details, and imports products from an Excel workbook.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Product category, a read-only code list.

tags.name: Detail Attributes
tags.description: Characteristic a product can carry, with its value type, unit and limits, a read-only code list.

tags.name: Detail List Values
tags.description: Allowed value of a LIST or MULTI_LIST attribute, a read-only code list.

tags.name: Detail Value Types
tags.description: Value type of a detail attribute, a read-only code list.

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Tells the caller whether the current user may change the catalog.

tags.name: Product Detail Selections
tags.description: Selected list value of a MULTI_LIST detail row, written only through the product's draft.

tags.name: Product Details
tags.description: Detail row of a product: one attribute and its typed value, written only through the product's draft.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Product sold in the catalog, created and changed through a draft.

tags.name: Subcategories
tags.description: Product subcategory within one category, a read-only code list.

tags.name: Subcategory Attributes
tags.description: Detail attribute assigned to a subcategory, with the position of its field in a product's details.

{...}
--response-separator--
